original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹宗教与社区领袖接受培训，打击性别暴力
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹部分宗教与社区领袖于周一开始为期五天的培训，旨在加强他们在打击性别暴力方面的作用。培训由宗教领袖组织，挪威教会援助组织提供支持，牧师、伊玛目和社区领袖参加。组织方表示，宗教领袖在社区中具有影响力，可在改变针对妇女和女童暴力的态度方面发挥重要作用。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹宗教与社区领袖于周一开始为期五天的打击性别暴力培训
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A section of South Sudanese faith and community leaders on Monday commenced a five-day training programme targeting religious and community leaders to strengthen their role in combating gender-based violence (GBV).

key_facts.fact: 培训由宗教领袖组织，挪威教会援助组织提供支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The training, which began on Monday, is organized by religious leaders with support from the Norwegian Church Aid (NCA)

key_facts.fact: 培训汇集牧师、伊玛目和社区领袖，以提升其应对暴力侵害妇女和女童问题的知识与技能
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: brought together pastors, imams and community leaders to equip them with knowledge and skills to address violence against women and girls.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
